newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - June 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - June 11.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Wednesday's Daily Variety:
* Former MCA President Sid Sheinberg and Universal Pictures, a unit of Seagram Co Ltd, have ended their exclusive production agreement.
* The entertainment sector rallied Tuesday, buoyed by investors' newfound enthusiasm for cable stocks.
* Bryant Gumble, the former anchor of General Electric Co's NBC-TV's "Today" show, will be the lone host of "The 49th annual Primetime Emmy Awards" on Westinghouse Electric Corp's CBS in September.
* United Cinemas International, the chain owned jointly by Seagram Co Ltd and Viacom Inc, has continued its aggressive push in Germany with another six multiplexes.

* United Paramount Network President and Chief Executive Lucie Salhany gave a farewell address to UPN affiliates, telling them she will stay "on the sidelines rooting: after she leaves. Viacom's Paramount and Chris-Craft Industries Inc launched UPN in Jnauary 1995.
* Jan De Bont plans to make a movie about signals Native Americans received in the 1860s that they believed came from outer space.
